events.title: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox — The Future Is Vintage Tour
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Bundall
events.description: Postmodern Jukebox reimagines modern pop songs as vintage hits from various eras, offering a creative and nostalgic musical experience. Expect a show blending '70s rock, '80s Britpop, and contemporary chart-toppers with a unique twist.

events.title: Tom Gleeson: Out of Touch
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Bundall
events.description: Gold Logie-winning comedian Tom Gleeson presents his latest stand-up show, *Out of Touch*, known for his signature dry wit and no-nonsense comedic style. Expect sharp sarcasm and personal tales from the host of *Hard Quiz*.

events.title: Jim Jefferies: Son of a Carpenter
events.description: Australian-American comedian Jim Jefferies brings his *Son of a Carpenter* show, featuring razor-sharp storytelling, fearless social commentary, and brazen honesty. Expect a night of classic stand-up driven by personal tales.

events.title: SURFACE Festival
events.location: Miami, Burleigh Heads & Nobby's Beach precincts
events.description: An ongoing festival celebrating street art, music, live events, and workshops, featuring over 50 murals across Miami, Burleigh Heads, and Nobby's Beach. It's an ideal outdoor cultural immersion for creative types to explore on foot or bike.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection
events.description: A major exhibition at HOTA Gallery featuring 35 contemporary artworks from 25 leading Chinese artists, including large-scale installations, video, and sculpture. Offers a rare opportunity to explore one of the world's significant collections of contemporary Chinese art.

events.title: A Bigger View Exhibition
events.description: This exhibition brings together grand-scale masterpieces from the National Gallery of Australia and HOTA's local collection. It's a compelling display for those interested in art, history, and landscape painting.

events.title: ADHD Expert Panel Discussions and Q&A
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Bundall
events.description: HOTA hosts a monthly panel discussion and Q&A with ADHD experts, part of their Talks & Ideas series. This event is for those interested in psychology, neurodiversity, and human behavior, offering insights and audience participation.

events.title: HOTA Cinema — Free Screening
events.description: HOTA Cinema offers a free film screening on Tuesday morning, providing a curated, arts-house alternative for film lovers. Multiple other ticketed sessions run daily throughout the week.

events.title: Sleeping Beauty — The Pantomime
events.description: A lively family pantomime running multiple sessions daily, featuring comedy, music, and audience participation. This immersive community theatre experience at Spotlight Theatre welcomes all ages for fun and entertainment.

events.title: Eco Arts — Nature-Based Art Making
events.description: A hands-on, outdoor creative workshop inviting participants to make nature-based artworks using flowers, rocks, and other natural materials. Connect art and nature in this grounded community experience.

events.title: Gold Coast Libraries — Game On! School Holiday Crafts
events.datetime: Mon 6 Jul - Fri 10 Jul, during library hours
events.description: A free, sport-themed craft program running during library hours at various Gold Coast Libraries. This welcoming community event offers a creative outlet for curious minds of all ages.

events.title: NAIDOC Colour Run
events.location: City of Gold Coast Chambers, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A joyful and free community colour run celebrating NAIDOC Week, open to all ages. Participants will enjoy a vibrant outdoor experience in Surfers Paradise.

events.title: NAIDOC Celebration March
events.description: A meaningful community march from Queen Elizabeth Park to Chris Cunningham Park in Coolangatta, marking NAIDOC Week. Join for a walk through a beautiful coastal area to celebrate Indigenous culture.

events.title: ArtLab — Sustainable Textile Art Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop at HOTA Gallery where participants create textile art using natural inks and dyes. Explore sustainable art-making in a relaxed and creative environment.

events.title: Festival of Chariots — Chariot Parade
events.description: A vibrant and free Chariot Parade held in Surfers Paradise as part of the Festival of Chariots. This cultural event offers a unique and festive atmosphere for the community.
